description: Chapter summaries the reader shows under a chapter's title, keyed by chapter number, per language. Like section headings they are editorial aids, not translation: written from Open Word Bible's own wording, stating what the chapter is about and nothing more, so every language can say the same thing. They use no reader settings. Every summary is an AI draft until a named reviewer approves it.

1.en: God tells Hosea to marry Gomer, an unfaithful wife, as a picture of Israel's unfaithfulness, and their children are given names of judgment.
1.sw: Mungu anamwambia Hosea amwoe Gomeri, mke asiye mwaminifu, kama picha ya ukosefu wa uaminifu wa Israeli, na watoto wao wanapewa majina ya hukumu.
1.am: እግዚአብሔር ለእስራኤል ታማኝነት ማጣት ምስል እንዲሆን ሆሴዕ ታማኝ ያልሆነችውን ጎሜርን እንዲያገባ ይነግረዋል፤ ልጆቻቸውም የፍርድ ስሞች ይሰጣቸዋል።

2.en: Israel will one day again be called children of the living God. Israel is like an unfaithful wife who chased her lovers, and God will strip her bare, yet God will lead her into the wilderness, speak tenderly to her and betroth her forever in faithfulness.
2.sw: Siku moja Israeli wataitwa tena wana wa Mungu aliye hai. Israeli ni kama mke asiye mwaminifu aliyewakimbilia wapenzi wake, na Mungu atamvua nguo, lakini Mungu atamwongoza mpaka nyikani, atasema naye kwa upole na kumposa milele kwa uaminifu.
2.am: አንድ ቀን እስራኤል ዳግመኛ የሕያው አምላክ ልጆች ተብለው ይጠራሉ። እስራኤል ወዳጆቿን እንደ ተከተለች ታማኝ ያልሆነች ሚስት ናት፤ እግዚአብሔርም ራቁቷን ያስቀራታል፤ ሆኖም እግዚአብሔር ወደ ምድረ በዳ ይወስዳታል፤ በርኅራኄ ያናግራታል፤ በታማኝነትም ለዘላለም ያጫታል።

3.en: God tells Hosea to love his wife again, as God loves Israel, and Israel will return to God in the last days.
3.sw: Mungu anamwambia Hosea ampende mke wake tena, kama Mungu anavyowapenda Israeli, na Israeli watamrudia Mungu katika siku za mwisho.
3.am: እግዚአብሔር እስራኤልን እንደሚወድ ሆሴዕም ሚስቱን ዳግመኛ እንዲወድ ይነግረዋል፤ እስራኤልም በኋለኛው ዘመን ወደ እግዚአብሔር ይመለሳሉ።

4.en: God brings a charge against Israel: there is no faithfulness, no loyal love and no knowledge of God in the land, and the priests have failed.
4.sw: Mungu analeta mashtaka dhidi ya Israeli: hakuna uaminifu, hakuna upendo usiokoma wala kumjua Mungu katika nchi, na makuhani wameshindwa.
4.am: እግዚአብሔር በእስራኤል ላይ ክስ ያቀርባል፦ በምድሪቱ ታማኝነት፣ ጽኑ ፍቅርና እግዚአብሔርን ማወቅ የለም፤ ካህናቱም ወድቀዋል።

5.en: Judgment is coming on Israel and Judah for their idolatry, and God will withdraw until they seek God.
5.sw: Hukumu inakuja juu ya Israeli na Yuda kwa ajili ya ibada yao ya sanamu, na Mungu atajitenga mpaka watakapomtafuta Mungu.
5.am: ስለ ጣዖት አምልኮአቸው በእስራኤልና በይሁዳ ላይ ፍርድ ይመጣል፤ እግዚአብሔርም እስኪፈልጉት ድረስ ይርቃቸዋል።

6.en: The people say, "Let us return to God," but their loyalty is like morning mist, and God desires loyal love more than sacrifice.
6.sw: Watu wanasema, "Tumrudie Mungu," lakini upendo wao wa uaminifu ni kama ukungu wa asubuhi, na Mungu anataka upendo usiokoma kuliko dhabihu.
6.am: ሕዝቡ «ወደ እግዚአብሔር እንመለስ» ይላሉ፤ ጽኑ ፍቅራቸው ግን እንደ ማለዳ ጉም ነው፤ እግዚአብሔርም ከመሥዋዕት ይልቅ ጽኑ ፍቅርን ይፈልጋል።

7.en: Israel is like a silly dove, turning to Egypt and Assyria instead of God.
7.sw: Israeli ni kama njiwa asiye na akili, anayeigeukia Misri na Ashuru badala ya Mungu.
7.am: እስራኤል ከእግዚአብሔር ይልቅ ወደ ግብፅና ወደ አሦር እንደምትዞር ማስተዋል የሌላት ርግብ ናት።

8.en: Israel has rejected what is good and made idols, sowing the wind and reaping the whirlwind.
8.sw: Israeli wamekataa yaliyo mema na kutengeneza sanamu, wakipanda upepo na kuvuna kimbunga.
8.am: እስራኤል መልካሙን ጥለዋል፤ ጣዖታትንም ሠርተዋል፤ ነፋስን ዘርተው ዐውሎ ነፋስን ያጭዳሉ።

9.en: Israel will not stay in the land but return to Egypt and eat unclean food in Assyria.
9.sw: Israeli hawatabaki katika nchi bali watarudi Misri na kula chakula najisi katika Ashuru.
9.am: እስራኤል በምድሪቱ አይቀመጡም፤ ወደ ግብፅ ይመለሳሉ እንጂ፤ በአሦርም ርኩስ ምግብ ይበላሉ።

10.en: Israel is a luxuriant vine that multiplied its altars, and its calf idol and its king will be carried away.
10.sw: Israeli ni mzabibu uliostawi sana uliozidisha madhabahu zake, na sanamu yake ya ndama na mfalme wake watachukuliwa.
10.am: እስራኤል መሠዊያዎቿን ያበዛች የለመለመች የወይን ግንድ ናት፤ የጥጃ ጣዖቷና ንጉሧም ይወሰዳሉ።

11.en: When Israel was a child, God loved him and called him out of Egypt, taught him to walk and led him with ropes of love. God's compassion will not let Israel be destroyed.
11.sw: Israeli alipokuwa kijana, Mungu alimpenda na kumwita kutoka Misri, akamfundisha kutembea na kumwongoza kwa kamba za upendo. Huruma ya Mungu haitaruhusu Israeli aangamizwe.
11.am: እስራኤል ብላቴና በነበረ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር ወደደው፤ ከግብፅም ጠራው፤ መራመድን አስተማረው፤ በፍቅር ማሰሪያም መራው። የእግዚአብሔር ርኅራኄ እስራኤል እንዲጠፋ አይፈቅድም።

12.en: Israel, like Jacob its ancestor, is deceitful, and God will repay them.
12.sw: Israeli, kama Yakobo babu yao, ni wadanganyifu, na Mungu atawalipa.
12.am: እስራኤል እንደ አባታቸው እንደ ያዕቆብ አታላዮች ናቸው፤ እግዚአብሔርም ይከፍላቸዋል።

13.en: Israel turned to Baal and calf idols and forgot God, and God will be like a lion against them, yet God will ransom them from death.
13.sw: Israeli walimgeukia Baali na sanamu za ndama na kumsahau Mungu, na Mungu atakuwa kama simba dhidi yao, lakini Mungu atawafidia kutoka kwa kifo.
13.am: እስራኤል ወደ በኣልና ወደ ጥጃ ጣዖታት ዞረው እግዚአብሔርን ረሱ፤ እግዚአብሔርም እንደ አንበሳ ይሆንባቸዋል፤ ሆኖም እግዚአብሔር ከሞት ይዋጃቸዋል።

14.en: God calls Israel to return and confess, and promises to heal their unfaithfulness and love them freely. Israel will blossom like a lily.
14.sw: Mungu anawaita Israeli warudi na kuungama, na anaahidi kuponya ukosefu wao wa uaminifu na kuwapenda bila masharti. Israeli watachanua kama yungiyungi.
14.am: እግዚአብሔር እስራኤልን እንዲመለሱና እንዲናዘዙ ይጠራቸዋል፤ ክሕደታቸውን እንደሚፈውስና በነጻ እንደሚወዳቸውም ተስፋ ይሰጣል። እስራኤል እንደ ሱሰን አበባ ያብባሉ።
